notes: PAP reference G10/2597. Direct-owner sale of a whole T3 apartment in La Chapelle-Saint-Luc's Vieille-Ville Centre area, approximately ten minutes by car from central Troyes. The complete live detail page describes 65.67 m2 on the first floor of a three-storey secure residence: entrance with storage, south-facing living room and fitted open kitchen, 12 m2 balcony, two bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC and a dedicated parking space. It also exposes double glazing, collective gas heating, solar preheating for domestic hot water, fibre, DPE and GES C from 23 December 2025, and 2025 taxe fonciere of EUR 1,066. The stated EUR 138,000 is the full apartment price. The source contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale, delayed-vacancy, managed-residence or special ownership wording. PAP exposed 13 property photos, a virtual tour and a publication date of 10 September 2026. The advert does not expose an elevator fact; the unusually described annual charge provision and regularisation amounts were retained only in this source note and were not converted into a listing charge field.
